title: Electric force magnitude
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state the electric force magnitude as 0.5mg or mg/2.

title: Electric force direction
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify the electric force direction as horizontal to the right.

title: Maximum speed expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final expression for maximum speed: √[gR(√5 - 1)].

title: Energy conservation setup
description: Important Criteria: The student must apply work-energy theorem correctly, accounting for both gravitational and electric work.

title: Centripetal force at B
description: Important Criteria: The student must set up Newton's second law at point B using the given normal force.

title: Resultant force geometry
description: Important Criteria: The student must analyze the geometry of the constant resultant force to find the maximum speed position.

title: Trigonometric relationships
description: Optional Criteria: The student should correctly derive sinθ = 1/√5 and cosθ = 2/√5 from tanθ = 0.5.

title: Sign error in work
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student incorrectly assigns signs to the electric force work in energy equations.

title: Direction confusion
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student misidentifies the electric force direction or confuses it with field direction.
